newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NS signs Dfl 170 mln contract with Siemens.
newsitem.headline: NS signs Dfl 170 mln contract with Siemens.

text.p: Dutch state-owned rail firm Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS) has signed a contract worth around 170 million guilders with Siemens Nederland for the supply of four high-speed trains, NS said on Saturday.
The first train, intended for the Amsterdam-Frankfurt connection, will be delivered at the end of 1998, it said in a statement.
NS added it had taken an option on additional trains but said no decision would be made on exercising it until more concrete plans for a high-speed link between Amsterdam and Berlin were known.
The trains can reach speeds of up to 330 kilometres per hour and seat around 400 passengers.
